title: 2D Pattern Viewer
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778377350937)Admin, ![Collaborator.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778392896537)Collaborator, ![Editor.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778377737113)Editor, ![Viewer.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778377880345) Viewer Compatibility: ZPRJ/ZPAC files uploaded from Dec 3rd, 2024. Please re-upload older files. # **Updates** CLO-SET supports 2D Viewer for ZPRJ/ZPAC files. 1. 2D Pattern Viewer 2. Show/Hide Toolbar 3. Mouse Navigation (Zoom/Panning) 4. Annotation 5. Deactivate 2D Pattern Viewer # **Details** ### 1) 2D Pattern Viewer * On the Content page, click the '2D' thumbnail button to begin. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55007150484633) *Compatible with ZPRJ/ZPAC files uploaded from Dec 3rd, 2024. Please re-upload older files. * By default, the 2D Viewer will match what is displayed in CLO3D software when the '2D > Point of Measure > Edit Point of Measure' option is turned off & Pattern Outlines unlocked. * All information display fields are turned off by default. | ![Screenshot 2024-11-26 at 1.43.46 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778393746713) | ![Screenshot 2024-11-26 at 1.43.58 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778412342937) ---|---|--- ### 2) Show/Hide Toolbar * On the 2D Viewer, find the display toolbar to control the view * Selective menus available at the moment. More to be released in near future. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54988956622233) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54988973448473) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54988973449241) ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54988973449753) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54988956627481) ---|--- * **Garment Display**(default: off) * Show Baseline * **Information Display**(default: all off) * Show pattern name * Show line length (displayed in mm only) * Show angle * Show grainline * Show 2D measurements (displayed in mm only) * **Garment Rendering Style** * Front Textured Surface - Default * Monochrome Surface * Translucent Surface * Transparent Surface * Mesh * **Pattern Lock** * Lock all pattern outlines * Lock all internal lines * Lock all baselines * Annotations * Show annotation (if there's no data, the button is disabled) * For more details on each menu, visit the **CLO3D** article on [**2D Window Display Icons**](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/articles/360011148874-2D-Window-Display-Icons) ### 3) Mouse Navigation (Zoom/Panning) * **Zoom** : Scroll up & down to zoom in & out * **Panning** : 2 options available 1. Wheel Click + Move Mouse 2. Alt (Option) + Left Mouse Button + Move Mouse ### ### 4) Annotation on 2D Viewer * You can create [Annotations](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219363481) on the 2D Viewer to communicate with your team ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55007135301913) 1. **Thumbnail** : Once Annotations are created, a blue label icon will be displayed on the Thumbnail & Version 2. **Annotation** : Find the Annotations 3. **Annotation Tab** : On the right pane of the screen, click on the Annotation button at the top to view the full list of Annotations created on the Content. Please note that the numbering will be shared between viewer types. That is, Annotations will be numbered in order of creation, regardless of the viewer type (3D or 2D). ### 5) Deactivate 2D Pattern Viewer Permission: Group Admin, Company Admin * 2D Pattern Viewer is activated by default for .zprj/.zpac files * To **deactivate** the 2D Pattern Viewer, visit [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page > General > Deactivate 2D Pattern Viewer toggle ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778395115161) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55002623624857)
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on using the 2D Pattern Viewer for ZPRJ/ZPAC files, detailing features, navigation, and permissions for effective collaboration and annotation.

title: Move Workroom/Style
content: # **Objective** You can move Workroom or Style page to the other Space(Season, Workroom) that you belong to. 1. Instruction 2. Drag & Drop to Child Workroom 3. Drag & Drop to Top Breadcrumb Navigation # **Details** ### 1\. Instruction ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55006285606041)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55006285614361) 1. Put a mouse cursor on the desired Style and click the icon 2. Select the contents you wish to change (multi select content: ctrl/cmd + left mouse button) and click 'Move'. You can select the desired Space(Season, Workroom) that you would like to move to. the Workroom or Style page will be moved accordingly. *You can also move multiple Styles with Multi-Selection (※ Note: Multi-Selection Manual) #### Multi Selection Mouse Navigation **Option** | **Description** ---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53461446091673) | Mouse left Button Drag from empty space to select multiple items Ctrl(Cmd) +**![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53461446096025)** | Add or remove items from the selection * Mac : Command / Window : Control * Previously selected items will remain selected. * Selecting an already-selected item again will deselect it. Shift + **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53461446096025)** | Select a range of items * adds all items between the most recently selected item and the currently selected item to the selection. ***** Multi-selection is supported **only in the Workroom (Content area)** ### 2) Drag & Drop to Child Workroom * To move the Content into Child Workrooms, simply drag & drop it to the desired Child Workroom * Single or multiple selected contents can be dragged directly into a **Workroom** ![dragdropmove-ezgif.com-video-to-gif-converter.gif](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/46262116285081) ### #### ### 3) Drag & Drop to Top Breadcrumb Navigation * Selected contents can be dragged to the **top breadcrumb navigation** * When hovering over a higher-level location, a **“+” indicator** appears, allowing the contents to be dropped and moved. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/53461446098073)
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for moving Workroom or Style pages between different Spaces using drag-and-drop functionality.

title: Company Setting
content: #### Permission: ![admin.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776386673433) Group Admin, Company Admin # **Objective** # **![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776379475737)** Company Admin can manage/set Company’s space and customize fields within Company Setting. There are 9 tabs in Company Setting - we will break it down to 5 in terms of usage. 1. General 2. Category / Content - Workflow 3. Content - Information 4. Rendering 5. Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type 6. Trash # **Details** ### 1) General General tab is where you can manage basic profile info and operation of the Company. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776442984345) 1. 1. Change Company name 2. Space Settings: * [Company Library](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303191826841) \- a unique Workroom where you can store commonly used Assets throughout the Company * [Line](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) \- an optional space level, between Brand & Season 3. Viewer Settings: turn on/off viewer options * [2D Pattern Viewer](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303154759705) * [Image Viewer](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185843865) 4. Accessible People - you may view the full list of users with access on each Space/Content 5. [Company Transfer](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985) \- Transfer the Company from current Group to another 6. Delete Company 7. Change logo color or profile picture for the Company 8. Manage Brands, Line, and Season within the Company ### 2) Category / Content - Workflow Category and Workflow are customizable fields, used to identify/search/filter the Content. ![Category.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776387263641) | | ![Workflow.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776387343897) ---|---|--- * **Category** : can add custom Category up to 4th depth * **Workflow** : can add custom Workflow stage, change name and color chips * Utilizing Category & Workflow * Identify the status of each Content * Filter or Search the Content using Category & Workflow * Quickly view the workflow status from Workroom ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776411956633) --- ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776412153881) ### 3) Content - Information ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55005930830489) * The Content Field is where information about the Content is stored. Users can customize the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Start storing Content information in CLO-SET to elevate your asset management flow. * Content Fields are tailored for each Content Type. Fields used can only be managed by Company Admin and Group Operator. To start adding custom fields, read the instructions below. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776380644377) * Before inputting information on the Content, we recommend that you review the fields used for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). * To add/edit Content Fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801), visit [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873). * Click on 'Content' > 'Information' to view the list of Content Types and Fields used. * Content Fields are shared and applied to all Contents within the [Company](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303185480985). #### **1\. Default Fields** * Default Fields can NOT be added or deleted. You can change the name, values, and unit format. * CLO-SET Provides tailored Defaults Fields for each Content Type. * For example, for Style type Contents, there are 6 Default Fields - material composition, customer type, color, price, MOQ, and date. * To edit the name, value, or unit format, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. On the Edit modal, edit the details and click 'Save'. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776444124697) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776381090201) ---|--- #### **2\. Custom Fields** * Custom Fields are fully customizable. Can create up to 16 Custom Fields per Content Type. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776396160153) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776444714137) ---|--- * To add a Custom Field, start by clicking the 'Add Custom Field' button. * Fill in the name and select the 'Type' of the field to be used. Fill in values or unit information when applicable, and click 'Save' to create the Custom Field. * Field Types provided are listed below. Once the field is saved, field type **CANNOT** be changed. * Text (up to 100 characters) * Textbox (up to 1000 characters) * Number (in unit format) * Date (in calendar format) * Dropdown: single-selection * Checkbox: multi-selection allowed * To **edit** the Custom Field, click the pencil icon at the end of the table. Changing the field details will impact the existing field information. * To **delete** the Custom Field, hover over the field row and click the trash button. Deleting the field will impact the existing field information, and the data stored will no longer be available. #### **3\. 'Number' Type Fields** **Unit Options** | **Currency Options for Price** | **Unit Format Example** ---|---|--- ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776389151897) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776389292057) | ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776429426329) * When editing the 'Number' type fields, you have an option to customize the unit format. * Please refer to the table below for placeholders used to customize the unit format. **Placeholder** | **Explanation** ---|--- 0 | The number of digits. Insignificant zeros are displayed in the result # | The number of digits. Meaningless zeros will not appear in the result . (decimal point) | Format numbers with decimal separators , (rest) | Specifies a thousands separator in a number ### 4) Rendering Add a [Render Preset](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303207727129) to share throughout the Company as a guideline. In Company Settings, you can Add/Change/Delete the Preset file (ZVRP) for your Company. Click on the link to find out more. ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776397015961) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776445548697) ---|--- ### 5) Status / Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type Customizable Fields are available for use on [Line Sheet - List Mode](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303220619289) to detail each Colorway. Add new fields for your Company, and start utilizing them on Line Sheet. ![Status.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776398996121) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776397606809) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776414449817) | ![Screenshot](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776398032153) ---|---|---|--- * **Status** : Add custom fields to identify the status for each Colorway * Workflow can be set on Content level, and Status can be changed per Colorway on Line Sheet * **Customer Type / Sales Channel / Store Type** : Add custom fields to use on Line Sheet ![Line_sheet_-_List_Mode_4x.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776399728153) ### 6) Trash Deleted Contents/Workroom/Brand is stored for 30 days on the Trash tab. Company Admin may restore the deleted files by selecting them and clicking on ‘RESTORE’ button. ![Trash.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45776446586649)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for Company Admins to effectively manage and customize their company's settings, content workflows, and user access within the CLO-SET platform.

title: Content Type & ID
content: # **Objective** Any 3D/2D/other files uploaded on CLO-SET is designated as a Content. For each Content, you may identify the Content Type to be used throughout CLO-SET, including Tech Pack and Line Sheet. You may also search for relevant Content Type & ID by using [General Search](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002203035) Function. 1. Content Type 2. Content ID 3. Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) # **Details** ### 1) Content Type Every Content is classified as a single Content Type in CLO-SET. At the time of upload, you may select the Content Type. Or, for specific file formats, CLO-SET will automatically assign a Content Type. *Any zprj/zpac files uploaded will automatically be identified as a Style Content Type. ![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778370822937)![Table \(1\) copy.jpg](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778335640729) #### ### 2) Content ID Content ID is a unique ID auto-assigned by CLO-SET upon file upload. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55006044921369) * Content created on or after April 9th, 2024 * Content ID is made up of **6 digit number**. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. * Content created before April 9th, 2024 * Content ID is made up of **3 letter Prefix** (Content Type) **\+ 6 digit number**. Each Group will have Content IDs starting from 000001. * Prefix List: ![mceclip2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778371347353) ### 3) Content Type in Web Tech Pack (BOM) You may add Fabric/Graphic/Trim information on [Web Tech Pack](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303168383385) \- BOM tab. Please note that the file format needs to match the Content Type to be added on BOM. ![Screenshot 2023-07-28 at 2.44.59 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778336186777)
content_description: This web page serves as a comprehensive guide for users to understand how to upload, classify, and manage various 3D/2D files as Content within CLO-SET, including details on Content Types, unique Content IDs, and their integration into Web

title: Content Details
content: # **Objective** You can edit the detail on each Content. Manage Content information to be reflected on Tech Pack, Line Sheet, etc. 1. Content Details 2. Permission # **Detail** ### 1) Content Details ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55005930830489) 1. [**Content Type**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801)**:** zpac/zprj files are auto-identified as Style. You may choose the Content Type when uploading the file. 2. **Content Name:** Used throughout CLO-SET features including Line Sheet, Tech Pack, etc. You may edit the Content Name anytime by double-clicking on the field. 3. [**Linked Content**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303217993881)**/**[**Notification**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303197105177)**/**[**Favorite**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303219472153) : * Linked Content: You can easily check the list of Parent/Child Contents. * Notification/Favorite: Click the bell icon to turn on the notification of this Content. You may also add this to your Favorite list. 4. [**Workflow**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303233641241)**:** Shows the Workflow of each Content. You may change the Workflow anytime using the drop-down menu. Workflow names can be customized on [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. 5. [**Content ID**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801) * Content ID: Unique ID auto-created by CLO-SET and can NOT be edited. You may search the Content using Content ID. * Thumbnail: Thumbnail images are extracted from the original 3D file when applicable. 6. [**Score**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303244420889) : Score rating of the Content. A numerical value from 1 to 10. 7. [**Category**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303202913049)**:** Add Content Category to easily search and manage the files. You may customize your Category names and hierarchy on [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack and Line Sheet. 8. **Tags** : Insert Tags on your Content. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack and Line Sheet. 9. **Description** : Enter additional description. This will be reflected on your Tech Pack. 10. [**Content Information Fields**](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303239598617) : Click 'More information' and add more information (material composition / customer type / color / Price / MOQ / Date). Manage Content information with customizable fields for each [Content Type](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303171019801). Fields can be added/edited in [Company Settings](https://clo-set-hc.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303214894873) ##### **Tips) Tag Recommendation** 1. **Auto-complete for Existing Tags** When entering a tag on the Content Page, the system now provides an auto-complete function that suggests existing tags. ex) Typing **“Leat”** will automatically suggest **“Leather.”** ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54775494821529) 2\. **Recommendation of 5 Recently Used Tags** Even before entering a tag, up to five tags will be recommended based on the following criteria: \- Among the tags registered under the same Company as the Content being tagged, \- The five most recently used tags by the same user will be suggested. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54775494822553) 💡 **Note** > If any of the suggested tags have already been applied, they will be replaced by the next most recently used tags. ### 2) Permission **Permission** : All Admins, Collaborators, Editors can edit Content Details / Viewers are read only
content_description: This web page aims to empower users with the ability to manage and customize content details for optimal reflection in Tech Packs, Line Sheets, and other related features.

title: Category
content: **Objective** Manage the Category of your Content. Customize the field names to match your workflow. 1. What is Category? 2. Category by Content 3. Category Multi-select 4. Category Settings 5. Filter by Category # **Details** ### 1) What is Category? * CLO-SET 'Category' is a customizable field that helps identify the Content, as well as filter the Content for a faster search. * Best Practice: * We recommend using the Category field for unique terms/labels for your team. * ex) 'Basic' line, 'Boyfriend' line, / 'Sunshine Orange', 'Midnight Blue', etc. * For generic terms, CLO-SET [AI-Search](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303182799641) will detect it for you. ![check+shirring+back+womens+swimsuit_Colorway](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777988210841) | ► | ![cat:tag2.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778003660185) ---|---|--- ### 2) Category by Content * Identify the Category of each Content. * Editors or above can make changes. * Fields are customizable by Company Admin or above in [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. ![Screenshot 2023-10-24 at 9.46.09 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777988508185) ### 3) Category Multi-select (Bulk Edit Category) * In your Workroom, select the Content(s). * From the multi selection bar above, click 'Category' (multi select content: ctrl/cmd + left mouse button) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55005025128345) * Select the Category to be applied to selected Contents.* * Please note that the pre-existing categories of each Content will be overwritten. ![Screenshot 2023-10-20 at 9.55.41 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777974212633) ### 4) Category Settings * Category fields are customizable in [Company Settings](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002215416) page. * You may add up to 4 depths of Category. ![Category.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778004362649) * The **View Options** toggle in the Category tab allows to choose between two display modes for how category information appears on the Content Page. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52576304797849) 1. Last Depth (Default) Displays only the final (deepest) category level selected for the content. This option keeps the category display concise and minimal. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52952048613785) 2\. Full Depth Displays the entire hierarchy of the selected category—from the top level to the final depth—within the Content Page information. This option provides full visibility into the category structure. ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/52952002283033) ### 5) Filter by Category ![Screenshot 2023-10-11 at 10.16.15 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45777974559001) ![Screenshot 2023-10-24 at 11.38.57 AM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778004637977) Search faster by filtering the Category. Filters are available on the [Search tab](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303160683161) OR in [Workrooms](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/en-us/articles/45303240419865). ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54999956371097)![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/54999972978713) Select the Category filter and choose categories to search. You can use AND or OR conditions: * AND: Includes content with both “A” and “B” * OR: Includes content with either “A” or “B”
content_description: This web page provides guidance on managing and customizing content categories to enhance organization and streamline searches within your workflow.

title: Workflow & Status
content:
# **Objective** Mark & Share the Workflow & Status of each Content/Colorway for effective collaboration. 1. Workflow vs. Status 2. Company Setting 3. Filter using Workflow 4. Workflow & Status in Line Sheet # **Details** ### 1) Workflow vs. Status ![Picture1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778183162649) **Workflow** | **Status** ---|--- Can create custom names in Company Settings Available to be edited by Admin / Collaborator / Editor Synced with Line Sheet * For each Content * Can be used as a search filter | * For each Colorway within the Content _**💡 Notes**_ > **Multi-select Workflow Change**
> > 1\. Go to your Workroom
> > 2\. Select the contents you wish to change (multi select content: ctrl/cmd + left mouse button)
> > 3\. Click 'Workflow' on the floating menu
> > 4\. Select the Workflow you want to update your contents to
> > 5\. Click 'OK' and you should see the new Workflow setting applied to the selected contents.
> > ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55002212832409) ![](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/55002246209689) ### 2) Company Setting Workflow and Status names can be managed in Company Setting. Please note that this can only be done by **Company Admin** and above. If you do not have the permission, please reach out to your Admin. 2-1) Workflow Setting * Enter your Company > Click 'SETTING' on the top left corner ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 2.25.36 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778188624281) * Choose 'CONTENT' to start creating custom names of workflow ![ddddd.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48031437609625) * Click "Set Leadtime End Status" button to select the end status, which should be considered as the final steps in the workflow. (This setting can maximize the accuracy of the workflow leadtime on each step) ![workflow endpoint setting 2 1.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/48031437613465) 2-2) Status Setting * Choose '**LINESHEET > STATUS**' to start creating custom names ![Screenshot 2023-09-04 at 3.36.29 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778183611289) ### 3) Filter using Workflow In your Workroom, you can Filter the view using the Workflow status. Simply select the color chip you'd like to view. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 2.43.41 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778174053657) ### 4) in Line Sheet In Line Sheet List Mode, you can view the Workflow of each Content, as well as the Status for each Colorway. Changing the Workflow/Status will be reflected on the Content Page, and vice versa. ![Screenshot 2023-09-05 at 2.49.17 PM.png](https://support.clo-set.com/hc/article_attachments/45778174243481)
content_description: "Streamline collaboration by marking and sharing the workflow and status of each content and colorway for enhanced visibility and effective management."
